Read and follow the project documentation.

Promptinator entry ID: prompt-0027-mirage-hare
Prompt formula: structured-v1

Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Mirage Hare".

## Creative brief

- Collection: Sunscorched Expanse. Desert enemies using sand, mirages, needles, heat, armor, and sudden bursts of speed.
- Core concept: A deceptive skirmisher that creates temporary false copies of itself.
- Body and silhouette: Slender hare body, extremely long ears, and narrow hind legs.
- Signature features: Shimmering ear tips, mirrored eyes, and a fading double-image trail.
- Palette and materials: Pale tan, sky blue, white, and heat-haze transparency.
- Movement personality: Playful, elusive, and unpredictable without being random.
- Attack concept: Creates two stationary mirage copies; all three fire, but only the real hare’s projectile deals full damage.
- Directional details: The real hare has a dark mark on its right hind leg.
- Avoid: Cute mascot rabbit, wizard robe, completely invisible real body.

## Interpretation rules

- Left and right refer to the creature's own anatomical sides and must remain consistent in every direction.
- Treat gameplay effects as motion intent: make the attack readable through body posing, and use the effects layer only where the category contract allows.
- Hard-alpha and style-contract rules override words such as translucent, glowing, soft, or transparent in the creative brief.
